steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Paper 2 of OCR J271 GCSE Law covers Law in Action — it is worth 80 marks and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Paper 2 Section A covers the Law of Tort: negligence, occupiers' liability, nuisance and remedies

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Paper 2 Section B covers two options from: Law of Contract, Consumer Protection, Company Law, Employment Law, Intellectual Property and Data Protection

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Alternatively, Section B may cover Rights and Responsibilities and Criminal Law in Context depending on the school's chosen options

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: For negligence questions, always address the three elements in order: duty of care, breach and damage — missing any element loses marks Name the key case for each legal test: Donoghue v Stevenson for duty of care, Caparo v Dickman for the three-stage test, Bolam for professional standard In tort scenarios, consider whether the claimant's own negligence contributed to the harm — contributory negligence under the Law Reform Act 1945 can reduce damages For Section B optional topics, check past papers to see how questions are typically phrased and structure your answers accordingly Always discuss remedies when concluding on liability — damages (compensation), injunctions and specific performance where relevant
